block.lightworks.edge_light.tooltip.acti: Changes its colour. It does not colour the blocks round it.
block.lightworks.edge_light.tooltip.beha: Glows _white_ and gives a little block light.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.edge_light.tooltip.summ: A low _marker_ for runway, taxiway and platform edges, bright enough to read from the air. Vehicles and players pass over it, and hundreds cost next to nothing.
block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.acti: Turns it round, or tilts it up and down.
Colours the lens, the beam and the light it casts.
block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.beha: Points _level_: away from you on a floor or ceiling, straight out of a wall.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.cont: When R-click is held on Pan or Tilt
block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.summ: A wide _cone_ for lighting an area: bright out to _12 blocks_, dark by 20. Mount it high and aim it down.
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.actio: Turns it round, or tilts it up and down.
Colours the lens, the beam and the light it casts.
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.behav: Stays lit _both ways_, dimmed by the signal.
Always lit: a Searchlight with a shorter, wider beam, pointing _level_.
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.contr: When R-click is held on Pan or Tilt
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.summa: A forward _beam_ for vehicles. On a moving contraption, train or Sable vehicle it lights only while _leading_, so Headlights at both ends swap over when it reverses.
block.lightworks.pan_tilt_head.tooltip.a: Makes it _sweep_ back and forth, this far either way of where it points now.
block.lightworks.pan_tilt_head.tooltip.b: _Pans_ the light round, as fast as the shaft turns.
_Tilts_ the light up 6° per signal level, straight up at 15.
block.lightworks.pan_tilt_head.tooltip.c: When R-click is held on the box
block.lightworks.pan_tilt_head.tooltip.s: A kinetic mount for a _Searchlight_, _Floodlight_ or _Headlight_ placed on top of it.
block.lightworks.rotating_beacon.tooltip: Colours the lens, the beams and the light they cast.
The beams turn _as fast as the shaft_.
Lights where the beams land, like two fixed Searchlights.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
Two opposite _beams_ that sweep round with the shaft: a rotating warning beacon for towers, airships and trains.
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.act: Turns it round, or tilts it up and down.
Colours the lens, the beam and the light it casts.
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.beh: Points _level_, away from you. Mount it on a _Pan-Tilt Head_ to sweep it round.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.con: When R-click is held on Pan or Tilt
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.sum: A long, narrow _beam_ that lights the block it points at: full out to _32 blocks_, dark by 48. Keeps landing where it points on contraptions, trains and Sable vehicles.
block.lightworks.tail_light.tooltip.beha: Glows dim red and gives a little block light.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.tail_light.tooltip.summ: A red lamp for the back of a vehicle. On a moving contraption, train or Sable vehicle it _brightens for a second_ whenever the vehicle slows down.
block.lightworks.warning_light.tooltip.a: Picks the _pattern_, and the lower row runs it _only at night_.
block.lightworks.warning_light.tooltip.b: Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.warning_light.tooltip.c: When R-click is held on the box
block.lightworks.warning_light.tooltip.s: An _amber_ lamp that shines steady, blinks, pulses, flashes or strobes, always or only at night, and lights the world round it in the same rhythm.
